body:
# **Useful Poisonous Potatoes** 

**Stop throwing away your toxic harvests! This Mod transforms the Poisonous Potato from a useless inventory-clogger into a versatile tool for farming, decoration, and villager revenge.**

### • Features : 

### 1. Compostable Poisonous Potatoes
You can now toss Poisonous Potatoes directly into a Composter. While they are toxic, they still provide organic value, allowing you to turn your bad luck into useful Bone Meal. What's more since the Potatoes are toxic they break down easier as compared to their non-toxic counterparts i.e. they have a 100% chance of turning into compost!

![Poisonous Potato Being Used To Make Bone Meal.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e62f419f6306ed7ed4cd93b4d4f72d4c16078b8c.png)

### 2. Mob Stunting
When fed to certain baby mobs, the Poisonous Potato now stunts their growth, preventing them from ever reaching adulthood. Perfect for players who want to keep a "perma-baby" pet for their base without them growing up into full-sized animals.

![Poisonous Potato Being Used To Stunt A Baby Animal's Growth.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9d0b81e1dabd196530ec7275d3ff5487e2738fa.png)

### 3. Villager Defense Mechanism
The highlight of this Mod is a complete overhaul of how Villagers handle conflict. If your reputation for a particular Villager drops to -200 ( The lowest reputation possible ) due to assault or murder, he will no longer remain passive. Instead the Villager will now pull out a Poisonous Potato and stare you down, pivoting to track your every move while lobbing Poisonous Potatos at you from up to 16 blocks away. Villagers will also share "gossip" about your bad behavior at meeting points like the Village Bell, causing your reputation—and the potato attacks—to spread from one Villager to the next.

![Poisonous Potato Being Used By A Villager To Ward The Player Away.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95255d785003301added3df4b6b145b043bf5876.png)

However if you are invisible and naked, you can slip by undetected (0% visibility). But Be Warned! Wearing Armor (+25% visibility per piece) or holding items (+10% visibility per hand) will give your location away! 

For a more permenant solution you can work to improve your reputation ( By trading or defeating a raid ), which will cause the Villagers to recognize your change of heart. Once your reputation rises above -200, they will put their potatoes away and return to their peaceful lives.
